_comment: One entry per photo in /products. `image` is the processed file written to public/uploads. `product` seeds the shop; `gallery_for` adds a second angle to an existing product; `role: artist` is the bio portrait. `box` = where the sculpture is (fractions x0,y0,x1,y1) when the centred default misses.

photos.note: the three insects together — used on the home page

product.name: Bolt Puppy
product.subtitle: Nuts for a head, a spring for a spine
product.description: Five bolts, a handful of nuts and one coil spring, welded into a puppy that is permanently pleased to see you. Sits on any shelf, never chews the furniture, never needs walking.
product.materials: Steel bolts, hex nuts, coil spring

product.name: Grater Owl
product.subtitle: A kitchen grater with opinions
product.description: The chest is an old grater, the ears are two long screws, the stare is entirely its own. Faces the door and silently judges everyone who comes through it.
product.materials: Steel grater, screws, sheet steel, forged rod

product.name: Owl on a Perch
product.subtitle: Spoon wings, a mesh chest, one bent bar
product.description: Wings from two spoons, a chest of hexagonal mesh, and a perch that curls up out of a heavy round base so it can watch the room from above. The one Genka's colleagues argue over.
product.materials: Spoons, steel mesh, round bar, steel base

product.name: Scorpion
product.subtitle: Chain links, hooks and a sting in the tail
product.description: Every segment is a chain link, the claws are two lifting hooks, and the tail curls exactly the way you would rather it didn't. Harmless. Probably.
product.materials: Steel chain, hooks, forged rod

product.name: Steel Rose
product.subtitle: The rose that outlives all the others
product.description: Petals cut and folded one at a time from sheet steel, then welded onto a stem with two leaves. It never wilts, never needs water, and cannot be quietly regifted.
product.materials: Sheet steel, round bar

product.name: The Pack — three dogs
product.subtitle: Set of three: the terrier, the bulldog and the hound
product.description: Three small dogs from bolts, nuts and springs, each with its own personality problem. Sold as a family; separating them would be cruel.
product.materials: Steel bolts, hex nuts, coil springs, chain

product.name: Chain Crocodile
product.subtitle: A bicycle chain with teeth
product.description: Its back is a full bicycle chain, its feet are springs, and its grin is a pair of pliers. Long, low and extremely patient.
product.materials: Bicycle chain, pliers, coil springs, steel rod

product.name: The Knight
product.subtitle: Mesh chain-mail, a sword, a shield — no fear
product.description: Mesh armour over a barrel chest, a sword raised in one hand and a shield with a brass rosette in the other, on a polished steel base. Undefeated, mostly because nobody has dared.
product.materials: Steel mesh, sheet steel, brass rosette, polished base

product.name: Little Bull
product.subtitle: Heavy nuts, forward horns, low centre of gravity
product.description: Built almost entirely from large hex nuts, which is why it feels like a paperweight and stands like a tank. Horns first, questions later.
product.materials: Large hex nuts, bolts, steel rod

product.name: Spoon Mouse
product.subtitle: Ears from two spoons, whiskers from welding wire
product.description: A mouse with spoon ears, wire whiskers and the slightly startled expression of something that has just been welded. For people who like mice at a safe, metallic distance.
product.materials: Spoons, welding wire, sheet steel

product.name: Dragonfly
product.subtitle: Four spoon wings and a ball-bearing body
product.description: Wings from four spoons hammered thin, a body of ball bearings, and a tail that tapers to a point. Lands on a shelf and stays there.
product.materials: Spoons, ball bearings, steel rod

product.name: Bearing Snail
product.subtitle: The shell is a ball bearing. The hurry is not.
product.description: A ball bearing for a shell, two bolts for eye-stalks, and a body that is going somewhere, eventually. The smallest piece in the collection and one of the most loved.
product.materials: Ball bearing, bolts, sheet steel

product.name: Hummingbird at the Flower
product.subtitle: A bird, a flower, one long curved stem
product.description: A hummingbird with spoon wings hovers at a steel flower on a tall curved stem. Tall, light and quiet — the piece that goes on the windowsill.
product.materials: Spoons, sheet steel, round bar

product.name: The Floor Scrubber
product.subtitle: A monument to everyone who has ever been told to clean up
product.description: On his knees with a brush, on a perforated steel plate, scrubbing for eternity. Genka made it after a particularly long shift. Every cleaner who sees it laughs; every boss looks away.
product.materials: Steel rod, perforated plate, natural-bristle brush

product.name: Ostrich
product.subtitle: Fork feathers, a spoon body, legs that mean business
product.description: Two forks for wings, a spoon for a body and a neck that stretches up out of a bolt. It looks as though it is about to ask you something.
product.materials: Forks, spoon, bolts, steel rod

product.name: Octopus
product.subtitle: A polished dome, two eyes and eight reasons to keep your distance
product.description: A polished steel dome for a head, ball bearings for eyes, and tentacles that curl under it as if it has just landed. Sits perfectly flat, weighs more than you expect.
product.materials: Polished steel dome, ball bearings, forged rod

product.name: Vespa Rider
product.subtitle: Man, scooter, ball bearings for wheels
product.description: A rider hunched over a scooter built from bolts and two ball bearings. Looks fast even standing still — and the wheels actually turn.
product.materials: Steel bolts, ball bearings, sheet steel, brass

product.name: Green Tractor
product.subtitle: An electric-motor rotor for an engine, bearings for wheels
product.description: The engine block is a real electric-motor rotor, the wheels are ball bearings, and the paint is tractor green, as it should be. For people who owned a toy exactly like this and lost it.
product.materials: Motor rotor, ball bearings, sheet steel, enamel paint

product.name: Anchor
product.subtitle: Chain, shackles, a ring — and it holds
product.description: A proper anchor in stainless steel with its own chain and shackle. For sailors, ex-sailors and anyone who wants something in the house to hold on to.
product.materials: Stainless steel, chain, shackle

product.name: Rooster
product.subtitle: A saw blade for a comb, pliers for a beak
product.description: The comb is a saw blade, the beak is a pair of pliers, the body is a polished spoon, and the attitude is one hundred percent rooster. Crows silently at dawn, which is the best kind.
product.materials: Saw blade, pliers, spoon, screws

product.name: Cat & Ball
product.subtitle: Spring body, hook tail, one brass ball to bat around
product.description: A cat with a coiled spring for a body and a hook for a tail, mid-pounce on a brass ball, mounted on a polished wooden base. Never knocks anything off the shelf.
product.materials: Coil spring, steel hook, brass ball, hardwood base

product.name: The Embrace
product.subtitle: Two crane hooks, one hug
product.description: Two lifting hooks bent into a couple holding each other — one head in brass, one in black with a mane of rubber strips. Heavier than it looks, like most relationships.
product.materials: Crane hooks, brass ball, rubber, steel base

product.name: Stone Bull
product.subtitle: A river stone in a steel harness, horns included
product.description: The body is a real river stone held in a welded steel frame; the horns, legs and nose ring are steel. Every one is different, because every stone is.
product.materials: River stone, steel band, bolts, forged rod

product.name: Sailing Ship
product.subtitle: Steel sails, a pennant, and a hull that never leaks
product.description: A tall ship with sheet-steel sails and a flag at the masthead, mounted on a round base. Stands about as high as a bottle of wine and looks better on the table.
product.materials: Sheet steel, round bar, steel base

product.name: Shell Chopper
product.subtitle: A motorbike with seashell fenders and pebbles for cargo
product.description: A chopper whose fenders are two scallop-shell dishes filled with beach pebbles and a tiny anchor. Beach holiday and biker fantasy in one object.
product.materials: Steel shell dishes, spoons, bolts, pebbles

product.name: Pliers Donkey
product.subtitle: The head is a pair of pliers. So are the ears.
product.description: A donkey with a pliers head, a spring body and the stubborn stance of the real thing. Will not be moved; is not meant to be.
product.materials: Pliers, coil spring, bolts, hex nuts

product.name: Drinking Buddies — bottle holder
product.subtitle: Two friends, two bottles, one long evening
product.description: Two figures leaning back to hold your bottles at exactly the angle of a good night. Holds two standard bottles; the friends are included, the drinks are not.
product.materials: Steel rod, steel band

product.name: Sisyphus
product.subtitle: One man, one rock, no end in sight
product.description: Bent under a real rock, forever pushing it up the plate. Genka made this after a double shift. He says it is not autobiographical. Nobody believes him.
product.materials: Steel rod, natural stone, polished steel base

product.name: Money Tap
product.subtitle: A brass valve that pours coins
product.description: A real brass valve with a red handwheel, and out of it a stream of coins landing in a pile. The most requested piece by far, for reasons everybody understands.
product.materials: Brass valve, steel, coins

product.name: Him & Her
product.subtitle: Spoon bodies, fork hair, a chain and a ribbon
product.description: He has a chain necklace and spiky hair; she has fork-tine curls and a ribbon. Sold as a pair. They have been standing next to each other for a long time and are used to it.
product.materials: Spoons, forks, chain, sheet steel

product.name: Thirsty Squirrel
product.subtitle: A fork for a tail, a bottle instead of a nut
product.description: A squirrel with a bushy fork tail, clutching a tiny bottle where the acorn should be. The bottle is included. What goes in it is up to you.
product.materials: Spoons, forks, steel rod, miniature bottle

product.name: Nut Giraffe
product.subtitle: Hex nuts, a long neck, and a cat for scale
product.description: A giraffe built entirely from hex nuts, tall enough that the household cat had to come and inspect it. The cat is not included.
product.materials: Hex nuts, bolts, steel rod

product.name: Lucky Horse
product.subtitle: A red horse leaping through a horseshoe
product.description: A bright red horse mid-jump through a horseshoe, on a polished steel base. Two kinds of luck in one, painted the colour of a good mood.
product.materials: Horseshoe, steel rod, sheet steel, enamel paint, polished base

product.name: HOME
product.subtitle: Four letters from bolts, nuts and one ball bearing
product.description: The word HOME in bolts, nuts and a ball bearing for the O. Stands on its own on a shelf or mantelpiece and says exactly what it means.
product.materials: Steel bolts, hex nuts, ball bearing

product.name: The Crowned Eagle
product.subtitle: Knife-blade wings, a spoon body and a golden crown
product.description: Wings of table knives fanned out mid-flight, a body of polished spoons, and a small gold crown. The largest bird in the collection and the piece people photograph first.
product.materials: Table knives, spoons, brass crown, steel rod

product.name: Lion King
product.subtitle: A mane of chain, a crown, and gilded legs
product.description: A lion with a mane of heavy chain, a gold crown, and legs made from gilded spoon handles. Stands like it owns the room, because it does.
product.materials: Steel chain, hex nuts, gilded spoon handles, brass crown

product.name: Three Wise Monkeys
product.subtitle: See no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil — under a palm of forks
product.description: The three monkeys of the proverb, built from bolts and nuts, sitting under a palm tree of forks, with an evil-eye bead for insurance. Office-appropriate wisdom.
product.materials: Steel bolts, hex nuts, forks, glass bead, steel plate

existing_products._comment: The three insects from the first photo keep their pictures; prices are re-set to the new range.
